long_biography.plain_text:
Venezuelan financier Ignacio Oberto served as treasurer of Bull Capital Securities, a Panama brokerage whose activities included securities dealing and investment administration. The company held a local brokerage licence before its board decided on voluntary liquidation in 2015.

Oberto also participates in showjumping as a rider and horse owner. Competing under his full name, Ignacio Enrique Oberto Anselmi, he has represented Venezuela at international meetings in Mexico. His mare Fursina VDM has also competed with other riders. They include Pablo Barrios at the Kentucky Summer Horse Show and Benigno Alfaro Herrera in Mexico.
